description: This file defines the interface for the secril-client, a client API for interacting with the RIL (Radio Interface Layer) in an Android environment. It includes type definitions, function prototypes for managing RIL client connections, registering handlers, and controlling audio and clock settings.
external_methods: int RegisterUnsolicitedHandler(HRilClient client, uint32_t id, RilOnUnsolicited handler)
int RegisterRequestCompleteHandler(HRilClient client, uint32_t id, RilOnComplete handler)
int RegisterErrorCallback(HRilClient client, RilOnError cb, void *data)
int InvokeOemRequestHookRaw(HRilClient client, char *data, size_t len)
int SetCallVolume(HRilClient client, SoundType type, int vol_level)

classes.name: RilClient
classes.description: Structure representing a RIL client handle with a private pointer.

methods.name: OpenClient_RILD
methods.description: Opens a multi-client connection to RILD, returning a handle or NULL on error.

methods.name: CloseClient_RILD
methods.description: Closes the RILD multi-client connection, disconnecting if connected.

methods.name: Connect_RILD
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the RIL daemon.

methods.name: isConnected_RILD
methods.description: Checks if the RIL connection is active.

methods.name: RegisterUnsolicitedHandler
methods.description: Registers a handler for unsolicited responses.

methods.name: RegisterRequestCompleteHandler
methods.description: Registers a handler for solicited responses.

methods.name: InvokeOemRequestHookRaw
methods.description: Sends a raw OEM request to the RIL.

methods.name: SetCallVolume
methods.description: Sets the in-call volume for a specified sound type.

methods.name: SetCallAudioPath
methods.description: Sets the external sound device path for noise reduction.

methods.name: SetCallClockSync
methods.description: Sets the modem clock to master or slave mode.
